plan.title: Oak Bowl: Finished to Forest
plan.summary: Opens with the finished oiled oak bowl, then traces back to a fallen-tree blank through lathe shaping, sanding, and oiling to explain how it was made.

segments.label: Finished bowl opening
segments.reason: Visible finished bowl centered on dark planks with clear concentric grain. Choice rests on speech transcript [0.0–5.0] stating it is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready; end moved back to sentence boundary at 4.6 s.

segments.label: Origin setup
segments.reason: Same bowl view holds while narration reframes it to its origin. Choice rests on speech transcript [5.0–8.0] that it started as a rough blank from a fallen tree; start moved back to sentence start at 4.6 s.

segments.label: Raw blank
segments.reason: Visible rougher, muted cross-section with darker edge signals raw material. Choice rests on speech transcript [8.0–12.0] describing the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy.

segments.label: Lathe shaping
segments.reason: Visible tool at bowl edge with shavings and circular turning marks shows shaping. Choice rests on speech transcript [16.0–20.0] about the shape appearing on the lathe in long, steady cuts.

segments.label: Sanding
segments.reason: Visible smoother surface with fine turning rings as work continues. Choice rests on speech transcript [24.0–29.0] about sanding from coarse to fine with the lathe turning slowly.

segments.label: Oiling color
segments.reason: Visible warmer, deeper grain glow consistent with oiling. Choice rests on speech transcript [32.0–36.0] that a coat of food safe oil brings out the color.

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.

review.verdict: Solid story but slow start - same bowl holds 8s before making begins, tighten to make it grip.
review.caption_suggestion: Fallen oak to finished bowl in 25 seconds
strengths: Clear finished-to-process arc serves the goal
Logical build: blank to lathe to sanding to oiling

fixes.what: Trim the duplicated finished-bowl hold and cut to raw blank by ~5s
Differentiate lathe vs sanding visuals to avoid 9s same-spin feel
